businesses.business: government health and human services program administration

offering_description.value: Operates and administers government health and human services programs on an outsourced basis. It provides program enrollment, eligibility, call center, claims, appeals and citizen engagement services, plus related technology and consulting, mainly to government agencies.

primary_services.value: government program administration outsourcing; contact center and citizen engagement; eligibility and enrollment support; appeals and independent medical review; technology and advisory consulting

customer_segment.value: B2G: federal, state and local government agencies running Medicare, Medicaid, veterans and employment programs; B2B: some commercial clients and foreign government agencies via contracts

end_markets.value: government health programs; Medicaid and Medicare; social services; veterans' benefits; student loan servicing; employment services

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price, cost-plus and performance-based government contracts; transaction or usage fees: per-transaction or per-unit fees for enrollments, calls and claims processed; service fees: time-and-materials technology and consulting work
revenue_model.category: project or contract; transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: service provider: outsourced operator of government program functions using staff and technology, sold to government agencies

geography_served.value: global: United States primarily, plus Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Saudi Arabia, Singapore and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: U.S. federal services, U.S. state and local services, and outside-U.S. program services sharing government clients

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: competitive bids and proposals to government agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: government contracting rules (FAR), HIPAA data privacy, and Medicaid/Medicare program requirements, no operating license
